title: FastFPS-Optimized
description: Lightweight performance modpack for maximum FPS and smooth gameplay.
body:
#  fastfps-optimized

**Maximum FPS, minimum lag – pure performance optimization for Minecraft.**

---

## ✨ Features

- 🚀 **Significant FPS boost** – Play smoothly even on low-end PCs
- 🧹 **Lightweight** – No gameplay changes, no bloat
- 🔧 **Core optimization mods** – Sodium, Lithium
- 🎮 **Client-side only** – Works on any vanilla server

---

## 📦 Compatibility

| | |
|---|---|
| **Minecraft** | 1.20.1+ |
| **Mod Loader** | Fabric |
| **Side** | Client only |
| **Java** | 17 or higher |

---

## 🔧 Installation

1. Download the `.mrpack` file
2. Import into **Modrinth App**, **Prism Launcher**, or any launcher that supports `.mrpack`
3. Launch and enjoy smooth gameplay!

> Optional: Add Iris + shader packs for better visuals without major performance loss.
